summary: Frontend-only visual refinement verification for Relais IT single-page site. All 13 requested feature checks PASS. Logo (/logo-relais.png) renders correctly in header (naturalWidth=1620) and footer. Hero, Services (6), Notre méthode (3 method-cards), À propos (3 about-values), Pourquoi (6 why-cards), Formations (3), Contact (no form, 3 cards + 3 CTA buttons with correct tel/mailto/wa hrefs), Footer (compact, Trust it., copyright) all match spec. Section order top-to-bottom is correct (Hero → Services → Solutions → À propos → Pourquoi → Formations → Contact). No legacy solution-card-* nor 'En savoir plus' links remain. Header nav and CTA smooth-scroll work. Mobile (390px): header height 81px, logo 112px, hamburger menu opens & closes. No JS/console errors during load.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx uses dynamic data-testid based on French label (`contact-${c.label.toLowerCase()}`) which yields IDs like 'contact-téléphone' (contains accent). Works but fragile; prefer fixed slugs (contact-phone-card, contact-email-card, contact-location-card).
Solutions.jsx component is named 'Solutions' but content is 'Notre méthode' / METHOD — consider renaming the component file/export to Method.jsx for clarity (low priority, cosmetic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All visual refinement v2 checks pass on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Logo asset served from /logo-relais.png (1620x543) loads in both header and footer. Section IDs and data-testid attributes are consistent with spec. No backend testing performed (frontend-only request).
